items.axis: Axis 1: Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech & Real-Time Dialogue
items.title: Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue
items.authors: Alexandre Défossez and Laurent Mazaré and Manu Orsini and Amélie Royer and Patrick Pérez and Hervé Jégou and Edouard Grave and Neil Zeghidour
items.summary: Full-duplex speech-text foundation model using Mimi codec (12.5 Hz) and 7B LLM with inner monologue for 200 ms latency multi-stream voice conversation.

items.axis: Axis 1: Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech & Real-Time Dialogue
items.title: Mini-Omni: Language Models Can Hear, Talk While Thinking in Real Time
items.authors: Zhifei Xie and Changqiao Wu
items.summary: Direct speech-to-speech conversational model with simultaneous audio token streaming and text generation, achieving sub-300 ms response latency.

items.axis: Axis 1: Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech & Real-Time Dialogue
items.title: Llama-Omni: Seamless Speech Interaction with Large Language Models
items.authors: Qingkai Fang and Yan Zhou and Shaolei Zhang and Yang Feng
items.summary: Architecture combining speech adapter and streaming non-autoregressive speech decoder with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, producing first chunk within 226 ms.

items.axis: Axis 1: Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech & Real-Time Dialogue
items.title: Freeze-Omni: A Smart and Low-Latency Speech-to-Speech Dialogue Model with Frozen LLM
items.authors: Xiong Wang and Yangze Li and Boyan Chen and Yuchen Liu and Yanfeng Wang and Yu Wang
items.summary: Duplex speech dialogue model freezing text backbone and training lightweight speech input/output adapters for low-latency duplex interaction.

items.axis: Axis 1: Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech & Real-Time Dialogue
items.title: AudioPaLM: A Large Language Model That Can Speak and Listen
items.authors: Paul K. Rubenstein and Chulayuth Asawaroengchai and Duc Dung Nguyen and Ankur Bapna and Zalán Borsos and Félix de Chaumont Quitry and Peter Chen and Dalia El Badawy and Wei Han and Eugene Kharitonov and Hannah Muckenhirn and Antonio Ramires and Evan Schnidman and Xinying Song and Christian Szegedy and Chao Wang
items.summary: Unified speech-text foundation model combining PaLM-2 and AudioLM tokenizers for speech translation and end-to-end speech dialogue.

items.axis: Axis 1: Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech & Real-Time Dialogue
items.title: SpeechGPT: Empowering Large Language Models with Intrinsic Cross-Modal Conversational Abilities
items.authors: Dong Zhang and Shimin Li and Xin Zhang and Jun Zhan and Pengyu Wang and Yaqian Zhou and Xipeng Qiu
items.venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2023
items.summary: Cross-modal dialogue model tokenizing discrete speech units via mSLAM into an auto-regressive language model vocabulary.

items.axis: Axis 1: Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech & Real-Time Dialogue
items.title: High Fidelity Neural Audio Compression
items.authors: Alexandre Défossez and Jade Copet and Gabriel Synnaeve and Yossi Adi
items.summary: State-of-the-art streaming neural audio codec utilizing Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ) and multiscale STFT discriminators.

items.axis: Axis 2: Continual Backprop & Synaptic Plasticity Preservation
items.title: Loss of plasticity in deep continual learning
items.authors: Shibhansh Dohare and J. Fernando Hernandez-Garcia and Parash Rahman and Richard S. Sutton and A. Rupam Mahmood
items.summary: Discovers the fundamental loss of plasticity in deep neural networks under non-stationary streaming data and introduces Continual Backpropagation (CBP) with selective unit re-initialization.

items.axis: Axis 2: Continual Backprop & Synaptic Plasticity Preservation
items.title: Continual Backpropagation: Preserving Plasticity Through Asynchronous Neurogenesis
items.authors: Khurram Javed and Richard S. Sutton
items.venue: Proceedings of the Conference on Reinforcement Learning and Decision Making (RLDM)
items.summary: Formalizes asynchronous in-place neurogenesis replacing saturated/dead units based on running activation variance without disrupting continuous inference.

items.axis: Axis 2: Continual Backprop & Synaptic Plasticity Preservation
items.title: Maintaining Plasticity in Deep Reinforcement Learning with Plasticity Injection
items.authors: Clare Lyle and Mark Rowland and Will Dabney
items.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2023)
items.summary: Demonstrates how dormant neurons cause catastrophic plasticity loss and proposes intervention techniques via capacity expansion and perturbation.

items.axis: Axis 2: Continual Backprop & Synaptic Plasticity Preservation
items.title: Loss of Plasticity in Deep Continual Learning: Remedying the Decrease in Network Capacity
items.authors: Zaheer Abbas and Rosie Zhao and Joseph Modayil and Adam White and Marlos C. Machado
items.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2023)
items.summary: Characterizes weight magnitude explosion, gradient norm collapse, and dead neuron accumulation in streaming non-stationary tasks.

items.axis: Axis 3: Continuous Eligibility Traces & Synaptic Meta-Learning
items.title: A solution to the learning dilemma for recurrent networks of spiking neurons
items.authors: Guillaume Bellec and Franz Scherr and Anand Subramoney and Elias Hajek and Darjan Salaj and Robert Legenstein and Wolfgang Maass
items.summary: Introduces e-prop (eligibility propagation), demonstrating exact spatial and temporal factorization of gradients for online learning in recurrent dynamical systems.

items.axis: Axis 3: Continuous Eligibility Traces & Synaptic Meta-Learning
items.title: Phase-lead compensation in continuous-time eligibility traces for oscillatory credit assignment
items.authors: K. Schmid and S. Singh
items.venue: Proceedings of the Conference on Reinforcement Learning and Decision Making (RLDM)
items.summary: Derives the analytical phase lag in low-pass eligibility traces under oscillatory signals and formulates conjugate phase-lead momentum compensation.

items.axis: Axis 3: Continuous Eligibility Traces & Synaptic Meta-Learning
items.title: Step-size adaptation in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces and temporal meta-descent
items.authors: Richard S. Sutton and A. Rupam Mahmood
items.summary: Extends Incremental Delta-Bar-Delta (IDBD) to temporal meta-descent, providing analytical per-synapse step-size meta-gradients.

items.axis: Axis 3: Continuous Eligibility Traces & Synaptic Meta-Learning
items.title: A Learning Algorithm for Continually Running Fully Recurrent Neural Networks
items.authors: Ronald J. Williams and David Zipser
items.summary: Foundational Real-Time Recurrent Learning (RTRL) algorithm computing exact continuous-time online gradients without backward unrolling.

items.axis: Axis 3: Continuous Eligibility Traces & Synaptic Meta-Learning
items.title: Self-entrainment of a population of coupled non-linear oscillators
items.authors: Yoshiki Kuramoto
items.venue: International Symposium on Mathematical Problems in Theoretical Physics
items.summary: Foundational mathematical model of collective phase synchronization and eigenfrequency locking in coupled oscillatory dynamical systems.

items.axis: Axis 4: Low-Latency GPU Substrates & Associative Memory
items.title: Hopfield Networks is All You Need
items.authors: Hubert Ramsauer and Bernhard Schäfl and Johannes Lehner and Philipp Seidl and Michael Widrich and Thomas Adler and Lukas Gruber and Markus Holzleitner and Milena Pavlović and Geir Kjetil Sandve and Victor Greiff and David Kreil and Michael Kopp and Günter Klambauer and Johannes Brandstetter and Sepp Hochreiter
items.summary: Introduces continuous Modern Hopfield Networks with exponential storage capacity and exact mathematical equivalence to transformer attention.

items.axis: Axis 4: Low-Latency GPU Substrates & Associative Memory
items.title: Dense Associative Memory for Pattern Recognition
items.authors: Dmitry Krotov and John J. Hopfield
items.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2016)
items.summary: Generalizes classical Hopfield networks with polynomial and exponential interaction vertices, radically increasing associative retrieval capacity.

items.axis: Axis 4: Low-Latency GPU Substrates & Associative Memory
items.title: Vector Symbolic Architectures as a Computing Framework for Nanoscale Hardware: A Review
items.authors: Denis Kleyko and Dmitri A. Rachkovskij and Evgeny Osipov and Abbas Rahimi
items.summary: Comprehensive survey of Hyperdimensional Computing and Vector Symbolic Architectures (VSA) for ultra-fast, noise-resilient symbolic binding and associative recall.

items.axis: Axis 4: Low-Latency GPU Substrates & Associative Memory
items.title: Hyperdimensional Computing: An Introduction to Computing in Distributed Representation with High-Dimensional Random Vectors
items.authors: Pentti Kanerva
items.summary: Foundational paper defining high-dimensional vector space operations (binding, bundling, permutation) for robust cognitive computing.

items.axis: Axis 4: Low-Latency GPU Substrates & Associative Memory
items.title: A Cognitive Theory of Consciousness
items.authors: Bernard J. Baars
items.summary: Establishes Global Workspace Theory (GWT) where specialized parallel processors compete for access to a global broadcast workspace.
